answer_1.quote: Multi‑Turn Safety Alignment (MTSA) ... multi‑round dialogues are a critical application domain for LLMs, yet ensuring their security during such interactions poses significant challenges.
answer_1.outputs: adversarial prompts (jailbreak attacks) and safety‑aligned model responses in multi‑turn conversations

answer_2.quote: We use Attack success rate (ASR) to evaluate attack effectiveness. Also we evaluated the harm of the response with the help of GPT‑4o. For safety we report metrics on Beavertrail, CoSafe, AlpacaEval and MT‑Bench.

answer_3.quote: We used GPT‑4o as an evaluator and tested it on Cosafe, Beavertrail safety evaluation dataset.
